Enfrente, el Atlético ha marcado 8 goles en sus últimos cinco encuentros y tiene en Julián Álvarez a un delantero en un gran momento. El Levante, por su parte, ronda los 4.3 córners por partido en lo que va de temporada. articles.title: Leeds news: Dominic Calvert-Lewin set for new contract
articles.summary: England striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin is set to sign a new contract at Leeds United.
articles.body:
England striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin is set to sign a new contract at Leeds United.

The 29-year-old, who has scored 20 goals in 49 appearances for the Whites since arriving on a free from Everton , currently has a deal until 2028 at Elland Road.

The news will come as a blow to Manchester United, who are looking at bringing in a forward in January after Benjamin Sesko was ruled out for an extended period as he tries to recover from a shin injury.

The Old Trafford side had been linked with Calvert-Lewin and a potential transfer in the January window.

He was recalled to the England squad by Thomas Tuchel in March and, though he missed out on selection for the World Cup, was picked for the most recent Nations League matches, winning his 14th cap on 6 October in the 3-0 victory over the Czech Republic .

articles.title: El Jesé más implicado: "Yo hablo en el campo... y vamos a ayudar al entrenador"

articles.summary: El delantero se muestra autoexigente y pide unión en el vestuario para salir adelante
articles.body: Jesé Rodríguez ha comparecido en sala de prensa para analizar la actualidad del equipo tras el reciente relevo en el banquillo. El atacante se ha mostrado autocrítico con su rendimiento individual, pero también ha destacado la mejoría colectiva y el buen ambiente de trabajo que se respira en los entrenamientos: "El entrenador es el que ha elegido el club y vamos a ayudarle". El futbolista también ha restado importancia a la jerarquía que otorga el brazalete de capitán: "No necesito llevar el brazalete, yo hablo en el campo. Intento ayudar a la gente joven y a todo el mundo". En el apartado individual, Jesé ha reconocido que podría llevar mejores cifras goleadoras y no ha escondido su exigencia consigo mismo: "Creo que podría llevar dos goles más. He fallado dos ocasiones que debí meterlas. Soy autocrítico". Sobre la evolución del equipo, el delantero ha valorado positivamente las dos últimas victorias, que considera importantes para reforzar la confianza del grupo y seguir creciendo en diferentes aspectos del juego: "Después de estas dos victorias veo al equipo bastante reforzado, creo que hemos mejorado cosas, sobre todo a nivel de intensidad y sin balón". Por último, Jesé ha destacado la competitividad que se está viviendo durante las sesiones de trabajo y ha transmitido ambición de cara al próximo encuentro, que se disputará el lunes: "Los entrenamientos están siendo súper competitivos y estamos preparados para llegar el lunes e ir a por los tres puntos".

articles.title: Vargas quiere subirse al carro
articles.standfirst: Con su gol en la Copa del Rey, el suizo volvió a marcar con la camiseta del Sevilla casi un año después
articles.summary: Con su gol en la Copa del Rey, el suizo volvió a marcar con la camiseta del Sevilla casi un año después
articles.body: El estreno copero del Sevilla dejó una gran noticia en forma de nombre propio: el reencuentro de Rubén Vargas con el gol. Partiendo desde la banda izquierda, su demarcación preferida, el internacional suizo fue titular frente al Sporting de Hortaleza, anotando el tanto que supuso el 0-3 después de acompañar un contraataque conducido por Peque para luego definir a placer. De esta forma, puso fin a una sequía de casi un año sin marcar como nervionense, desde aquel penalti transformado en el triunfo ante Osasuna el 8 de noviembre de 2025. El camino de Vargas durante los últimos meses había sido tormentoso. Considerado uno de los principales activos del Sevilla tras un buen Mundial con Suiza, estuvo muy cerca de salir en verano, pero ninguno de los clubes interesados llegaba a las pretensiones económicas de la entidad. Finalmente, permaneció en Nervión, superó sus problemas de rodilla y reapareció en el Santiago Bernabéu. Sin embargo, fue una semana más tarde cuando empezó a mostrar una versión más consistente. Saliendo desde el banquillo en la victoria ante Osasuna, Vargas firmó dos pases clave, dos robos de balón y originó la jugada del segundo gol del Sevilla. Desde el flanco derecho, el extremo aportó dinamismo y gestionó las posesiones con inteligencia, además de implicarse a la hora de apoyar a Juan Iglesias en tareas defensivas. La pasada temporada, Luis García Plaza utilizó asiduamente a Rubén Vargas en la banda derecha y este le respondió con dos asistencias en los triunfos ante Atlético de Madrid y Villarreal. Ante la baja de Miguel Sierra, parece que será el futbolista helvético el que compita con Chidera Ejuke por la titularidad. El técnico madrileño apuntó hace algunas semanas la importancia de recuperar su mejor versión: "Estoy encantado de que esté, nos puede dar un registro diferente al que tenemos y tiene encima balón parado". Tras recuperar la confianza y con el aval de García Plaza, Vargas ha demostrado que está preparado para ayudar al Sevilla y asumir galones cuando el equipo lo necesite. No solo busca subirse definitivamente al carro del proyecto, sino convertirse en ese factor diferencial capaz de desatascar partidos.

articles.title: Aviso de Aranbarri: "Para llevar la iniciativa tenemos que recuperar la agresividad"
articles.standfirst: El entrenador del Eibar recupera a Sergio Álvarez, después de dos meses en el dique seco, más Arbilla, Bernat y Adu Ares
articles.summary: El entrenador del Eibar recupera a Sergio Álvarez, después de dos meses en el dique seco, más Arbilla, Bernat y Adu Ares
articles.body: El Eibar afronta en apenas una semana dos compromisos de entidad ante los dos equipos que están por delante suyo en la clasificación: Almería y Castellón, con una escala en Pamplona para el partido aplazado de Copa. Jokin Aranbarri encara el desafío con el positivismo que siempre le rodea y con el objetivo de volver a recuperar la mejor versión del equipo después de firmar una hora larga en Córdoba en la que sus jugadores no estuvieron a la altura de la exigencia. "El equipo siempre tiene ese fuego interior para intentar mejorar y sentir las cosas de verdad. Venimos de un partido en el que no estuvimos bien en general. El inicio fue bueno, pero después no estuvimos a la altura. Lo hemos sentido, lo hemos sufrido y enseguida le hemos dado la vuelta", manifiesta Aranbarri, que recupera a Arbilla, Bernat, Adu Ares y Sergio Álvarez, pero no podrá contar con Elgezabal y Gift. La única receta para doblegar al Almería pasa por ser ese equipo reconocible de los primeros dos meses de competición. "Recuperar esa agresividad que nos faltó durante sesenta y pico minutos. Creo que esa es una de las claves para llevar la iniciativa. Tenemos que ser verticales, ir a por el rival y conseguir que pasen muchas cosas, sobre todo en su campo", confiesa el técnico armero. Aranbarri se ha deshecho en elogios hacia el conjunto andaluz. "Es un equipo completo, sólido y al que resulta muy difícil hacerle daño cuando está organizado. Con balón tiene mucha capacidad para hacerte daño: puede atacar en posicional y, si vas a presionarle arriba, es capaz de jugar vertical. Domina muy bien todos los momentos del juego". El preparador azulgrana confía en ver a un equipo con ganas de reivindicarse. "Somos un equipo que casi siempre va al límite. Nuestra intención es no hacer nada a medias y tenemos dentro ese dolor y esas ganas de demostrar que lo del otro día no es algo que queramos repetir. Durante la semana se ha visto que vamos a todo, que vamos de verdad. Eso es lo que tenemos que demostrar mañana sobre el césped".

articles.title: US investors agree to buy 42% of Valencia, lifting the club’s valuation to €1.25bn and injecting €100m in fresh capital, while club continues to struggle deep in La Liga’s relegation zone
articles.summary: Valencia CF secures €100 million investment from Pitchwise Holdings, gaining fresh capital and a 42% stake, while fighting to avoid relegation in La Liga.
articles.body: Valencia are languishing in the La Liga relegation zone, their season threatening to become another difficult chapter in a club that has struggled to rediscover its former standing. Yet, away from the pitch, one of Spanish football's most recognisable institutions has attracted an extraordinary financial proposition, with some of America's wealthiest investors preparing to enter its ownership structureA €1.25 billion valuation and a new American partnershipValencia announced on October 23, 2026, that American investment group Pitchwise Holdings had agreed to acquire a 42 per cent stake in the club, valuing the Spanish side at €1.25 billion ($1.4 billion). The agreement represents a significant development for the La Liga outfit, which has been under Singaporean businessman Peter Lim's ownership since 2014.Pitchwise Holdings is a consortium of private family offices and long-term institutional investors, led by American sports executives Ann Rodriguez and Corey Woolfolk. Both will join Valencia president Kiat Lim in the club's new ownership structure, bringing experience across professional football, basketball and major sporting events.Rodriguez is a veteran sports executive with more than 25 years of experience in the industry. Her previous positions include working with Major League Soccer side Atlanta United, the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and the organising committee for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic Games. She also previously served as chief operating officer of the WNBA.Woolfolk, meanwhile, is a former professional footballer who founded Pitchwise in 2015. He subsequently developed experience across football investments, biotechnology and venture capital, combining his playing background with institutional investment expertise.The consortium's high-profile financial backing comes from Henry Kravis and George Roberts, the co-founders and co-executive chairmen of KKR, the global investment firm established in 1976 and listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Their involvement comes through personal family office investments rather than an announced corporate investment by KKR itself.Another significant investor is Penner Sports Group, the family-owned sports and entertainment holding company established by Greg Penner and his wife, Carrie Penner, in 2022. Greg Penner is chairman of Walmart, having succeeded his father-in-law, Rob Walton, in 2015, while Carrie Penner is Rob Walton's daughter and granddaughter of Walmart founder Sam Walton.Penner Sports Group's sporting portfolio includes the NFL's Denver Broncos and a minority interest in Major League Baseball's Colorado Rockies.What the investment means for Peter Lim's ownershipThe agreement brings new investors into Valencia without ending the Lim family's association with the club. Peter Lim, 73, will remain the majority shareholder through Meriton Holdings, while his son, 33-year-old Kiat Lim, will continue as president.Kiat succeeded Chan Lay Hoon in March 2025 and will now work alongside Pitchwise's Rodriguez and Woolfolk. Explaining why the American consortium emerged as his preferred partner, the Valencia president said:“There has been no shortage of interest in Valencia; the Pitchwise team was the only partnership I was keen to pursue. They bring long-term investment expertise and sports acumen, and we have got to know each other very well. With Ann, Corey, George and Pitchwise Holdings, I am confident that we are entering a new era and we can achieve great things for Valencia CF.”Pitchwise will also provide €100 million in fresh capital for immediate investment into the club, including support for its stadium ambitions. The funding accompanies the acquisition and is intended to strengthen Valencia's ability to invest in its football operations and infrastructure.Nou Mestalla could change Valencia's financial prospectsThe stadium project is central to understanding the scale of the investment, particularly given Valencia's difficult sporting circumstances. Construction of Nou Mestalla resumed in January 2025 after years of delays, with the €322 million development scheduled for completion in 2027.The proposed 70,044-capacity venue will replace the existing Mestalla, which accommodates 49,419 spectators. Once completed, it will be Spain's fourth-largest stadium, behind Barcelona's Nou Camp, Real Madrid's Bernabeu and Atletico Madrid's Metropolitano.For Valencia, the new ground represents an opportunity to substantially expand matchday revenue, hospitality operations and commercial partnerships, while potentially positioning the city to host matches during the 2030 FIFA World Cup.Lim's original acquisition of Valencia through Meriton in 2014 cost €420 million. The purchase involved addressing the club's €230 million debt burden and completing the stadium project, which had remained unfinished for years. According to Valencia, Lim has subsequently committed more than €200 million, the largest investment by an individual owner in La Liga history.The sporting situation tells a different storyValencia's financial ambitions currently contrast sharply with their performances in Spanish football. Under Mexican manager Javier Aguirre, the club are sitting 19th in the 20-team La Liga standings, having collected just six points from their opening ten matches.Their only victory came against Deportivo Alavés, whom they defeated 1-0 away from home. Valencia subsequently drew 2-2 against Racing Santander and 0-0 against Athletic Club, while suffering defeats against Real Sociedad and Villarreal.Their latest disappointment came on October 24, when Villarreal secured a 2-1 victory despite Valencia taking the lead through a Pepelu penalty. The result extended a difficult start for a side that have struggled to establish consistency at either end of the pitch.The problems have also extended beyond one disappointing campaign. During Lim's 11 seasons at Valencia, the club have finished in the top half of La Liga only six times and gone through 14 different head coaches, with Aguirre the latest appointment.There have nevertheless been successful periods, including three Champions League qualifications, a Europa League semi-final appearance and the 2019 Copa del Rey triumph. Valencia also reached the domestic cup final again in 2022.Investors see an opportunity to restore Valencia's standingDespite the club's recent decline, Pitchwise believes Valencia retain the foundations required to become a significant force in European football. Rodriguez and Woolfolk pointed towards the club's history, supporters and stadium development when explaining their decision to invest.“With its illustrious history, huge and passionate fanbase and a spectacular new stadium nearing completion, the club has all the building blocks needed to be a leading club in Europe in both men’s and women’s football.“However, we also know that the regulatory and competitive landscape of the modern game means that potential alone is not enough – it requires a clear investment strategy and focus.“We can’t wait to work with everyone at the club, including the fans, to deliver just that.”KKR co-founder George Roberts described the partnership as “the most exciting opportunity in European football”, while La Liga president Javier Tebas also welcomed the announcement.“This is very positive news for Valencia CF and for the city of Valencia as a whole. The alliance brings not only capital but also partners with deep experience in sports management and world-class investors.”Valencia's next league assignment comes against Elche on November 1, before a demanding meeting with Real Madrid the following week, leaving the club with immediate sporting problems even as its ownership enters a new chapter.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Celtic: Martin O'Neill agrees with Callum McGregor on issues
articles.summary: Manager Martin O'Neill says he is in "full agreement" with captain Callum McGregor's assessment of Celtic's issues, but insisted they will "sort it out".
articles.body:
Manager Martin O'Neill says he is in "full agreement" with captain Callum McGregor's assessment of Celtic's issues, but insisted they will "sort it out".

McGregor was asked about the team's struggles after Wednesday's 2-2 draw with Dundee United, describing some moments in games as being "a bit basketball" as Celtic lacked their usual control.

The 33-year-old also noted playing strikers like Callum Osmand and Camilo Duran as wingers may be contributing to those issues amid a run of three wins in nine games.

When O'Neill was asked about those comments before Sunday's match with Falkirk, he said he had "no idea" what McGregor said, but when the context was put to the Celtic manager he said he agreed with his captain's diagnosis.

"I totally agree that Callum Osmand is actually really a centre forward, I've said this at the press conference, that he is essentially a centre forward," O'Neill said.

"He probably would play off somebody strong alongside him, I'm not so sure that he could lead the line on his own.

"And that Camilo Duran is really a centre forward, so the players are getting to know each other, it's as really simple as that there, so I'm in total agreement with Callum."

Celtic & Rangers Scottish Cup stadium closure upheld

What have we learned from first round of Premiership?

Celtic still hold a four-point lead at the top of the Scottish Premiership, and will extend that to seven if they beat Falkirk on Sunday, with Rangers in League Cup action.

The defending champions have only lost once, at home to Rangers, in the league but have three Europa League defeats from three amid fan discontent and a boycott of some games by the Green Brigade fans group.

McGregor is not the first senior player to speak about Celtic's lack of control in games, with defender Cameron Carter-Vickers saying after their Glasgow derby loss that the team were "too random" in their play.

O'Neill, though, says the group will improve as more players get up to speed across the course of the winter and in the meantime are doing enough in the league.

"I come in here [to the press conference] every single week and I'm most of the time pretty buoyed by things," the Northern Irishman said.

"Don't try and throw a lot of divides in at the end of the day, we're doing fine.

"A lot of lads here didn't even do pre-season with us. A number of players came in quite late on, so it will take time for us.

"So we need to hang in there, and at this minute I think we're hanging in."

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo scores Al-Nassr hat-trick in 15 minutes, but Saudi legend calls his goals 'easy' and credits Joao Felix for 5-3 win
articles.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo scores a stunning hat-trick in just 15 minutes during Al-Nassr's thrilling 5-3 win, but former goalkeeper Mohamed Al-Deayea highlights Joao Felix's crucial contributions. Explore the dynamics of Al-Nassr's victory and Ronaldo's pursuit of 1,000 goals.
articles.body: Cristiano Ronaldo added another hat-trick to his extraordinary collection on Thursday, taking his career tally closer to a milestone that has eluded every footballer in the modern era. But while Al-Nassr celebrated a five-goal victory, one of Saudi Arabia's most celebrated former goalkeepers had a rather different assessment of the performance, directing his praise towards the Portuguese forward who provided the service behind Ronaldo's latest treble.Ronaldo's hat-trick seals five-goal victory for Al-NassrAl-Nassr defeated Al-Kholood 5-3 at Al-Awwal Park on Thursday night, with Ronaldo scoring three times in the second half after the contest had developed into an entertaining exchange of goals. Julien Domingues opened the scoring in the 16th minute before Angelo Gabriel and Sadio Mane also found the net for the Riyadh side.Antoine Essomba equalised in first-half stoppage time, leaving Al-Nassr with work to do after the interval. Ronaldo eventually took control of the contest, scoring in the 66th, 72nd and 81st minutes to complete a treble inside 15 minutes and secure all three points.The performance added another entry to the 41-year-old's remarkable scoring record, taking his Al-Nassr hat-trick collection to seven since joining the Saudi club in 2023. It was also the 67th treble of his senior career, including 44 for Real Madrid, 10 for Portugal, three for Manchester United and three for Juventus, alongside his seven for Al-Nassr.Ronaldo celebrated the result on social media, writing: "Great win, great team performance. Happy to help with a hat-trick!"Mohamed Al-Deayea believes Joao Felix deserved the attentionNot everyone was convinced that Ronaldo was the central figure behind Al-Nassr's victory, with former Saudi Arabia international goalkeeper Mohamed Al-Deayea directing his attention towards Joao Felix. The Portuguese playmaker supplied four assists against Al-Kholood, creating the opportunities that allowed Ronaldo and his attacking team-mates to make the difference.Speaking on Saudi television programme Dawrina Ghair, Al-Deayea described Felix as an important figure for both Al-Nassr and the wider Saudi Pro League, while questioning the nature of Ronaldo's goals."This player [Felix] is an asset to the Saudi League as a whole, not just to Al-Nassr. He is a starter for the Portugal national team, possesses every quality required of a top player, and can perform across multiple attacking positions. He is the heart and soul of the team - with all due respect to Cristiano Ronaldo, who scores easy goals thanks to the service provided by the wingers."Felix's contribution against Al-Kholood extended beyond his four assists, with the Portugal international orchestrating much of Al-Nassr's attacking play and repeatedly finding team-mates in scoring positions. Ronaldo finished those opportunities with three goals, but Al-Deayea's assessment was that the creative work deserved considerably more recognitionWho is Mohamed Al-Deayea, the former Al-Hilal goalkeeper?Al-Deayea is one of the most recognisable goalkeeping figures in Saudi Arabian football, having represented both the national team and Al-Hilal during a distinguished playing career. Born on August 2, 1972, the former goalkeeper is widely regarded as one of the greatest players in Asian football history.He began his senior career with Al-Ta'ee in 1989, making 176 appearances for his hometown club before joining Al-Hilal in 1999. During his 11-year spell in Riyadh, Al-Deayea made 237 appearances and won several domestic honours, alongside the Asian club title in 2000.His playing career ended with his retirement on June 22, 2010, although Al-Hilal organised a testimonial match against Italian giants Juventus on January 5, 2012, at King Fahd Stadium to recognise his contribution to the game.Ronaldo's pursuit of 1,000 goals faces a potential January complicationThe latest hat-trick took Ronaldo's career tally to 985 goals, leaving him just 15 strikes short of the unprecedented 1,000-goal milestone. The Portuguese forward now leads Lionel Messi, who has scored 936 career goals, by 49 in the race between the two long-time rivals.However, Al-Deayea believes the January transfer window could introduce another complication into Ronaldo's pursuit, particularly if Al-Nassr decide to strengthen their attacking options with another striker."If Cristiano doesn't score 15 goals before the winter window and the club goes on to sign a new striker, he won't be able to break the 1,000-goal mark."For Ronaldo, the immediate objective remains adding the 15 goals required to reach four figures, although Al-Deayea's comments have shifted some of the attention towards Felix and the role he plays in creating the opportunities behind Al-Nassr's prolific captain.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.standfirst: El exárbitro asegura que las razones políticas condicionan las decisiones del CTA
articles.summary: El exárbitro asegura que las razones políticas condicionan las decisiones del CTA
articles.body: EXavier Estrada Fernández vuelve a disparar con bala. El exárbitro está de nuevo en el centro de la polémica tras asegurar en el podcast 'La Renaixença' que la baja presencia de colegiados catalanes en la élite se debe a la "catalanofobia". A juicio del excolegiado catalán, que es cargo electo en el Ayuntamiento de Lleida por ERC, existe un sesgo ideológico y político a la hora de determinar los ascensos y la permanencia en las máximas categorías del fútbol español: "Por desgracia hay muy pocos árbitros catalanes en Primera. Podemos contar con los dedos de una mano los que llegan a primer nivel o a pitar internacionalmente. Tenemos más de 2.000 árbitros federados y si miras históricamente los que han llegado a lo más alto son muy pocos. Deberíamos valorar a la gente por su valía no por de dónde vienen". No es la primera vez que Estrada habla de catalanofobia en el fútbol. De hecho, en su libro 'El partit que no veus' (El partido que no ves) ya utilizó ese término para hablar de la discriminación que dice padecer en su etapa como árbitro. "Recuerdo estar de VAR con Mateu Lahoz, con quien tengo muy buena relación. Nosotros siempre hemos hablado en catalán, pero Velasco Carballo y Clos Gómez nos lo prohibían. Decían que no nos entendían en los análisis en el seminario. Nos lo recriminaron públicamente... después dicen que no hay catalanofobia". El éxárbitro fue incluso más allá en sus publicaciones: "La Federación y el Comité de Árbitros son instituciones franquistas que no se rigen por méritos, sino por una red clientelar brutal donde los que mandan terminan colocando a árbitros que les compran los favores".

articles.title: Sancet se apunta al derbi ante la Real
articles.standfirst: El mediapunta volvió a entrenarse este viernes con sus compañeros
articles.summary: El mediapunta volvió a entrenarse este viernes con sus compañeros
articles.body: El Athletic afronta este domingo el derbi ante la Real en San Mamés. Los rojiblancos llegan a esta cita tras encadenar dos victorias consecutivas, la copera cosechada el jueves ante el Prat y la liguera conseguida ante el Getafe. Un partido ante el que el conjunto donostiarra llega con mejor dinámica, pero en los derbis nunca hay favoritos. San Mamés recibirá a los leones por todo lo alto y además, en los prolegómenos del partido Iribar y Kortabarria replicarán la famosa foto del derbi en Atotxa con la ikurriña 50 años después. Los de Edin Terzic han entrenado esta mañana en una sesión de recuperación para los titulares en el partido copero ante el Prat. Un entrenamiento que ha dejado la gran noticia de que Oihan Sancet se ha vuelto a entrenar con el grupo y como ya adelantó Edin Terzic en rueda de prensa todo apunta a que el 8 rojiblanco estará disponible el domingo. En la sesión de este viernes, Christiam Imga y Txus Vizcay se han entrenado con el primer equipo después de haber visto portería en Copa ante el Prat. Por su parte, algunos futbolistas que estaban entre algodones como Djaló, Berenguer, Yuri o Laporte, han entrenado con total normalidad.

articles.title: La Federación desestima el recurso del Pinatar y el Elche seguirá en la Copa
articles.standfirst: El Juez Disciplinario Único rechaza la reclamación del club murciano por posible alineación indebida de Eze Ponce
articles.summary: El Juez Disciplinario Único rechaza la reclamación del club murciano por posible alineación indebida de Eze Ponce
articles.body: El Elche respira definitivamente en clave Copa del Rey. Este viernes, el Juez Disciplinario Único de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol (RFEF) ha desestimado el recurso presentado por la UD Pinatar por posible alineación indebida del franjiverde Eze Ponce, en el partido que midió a Pinatar y Elche el martes en tierras murcianas (1-3 para los ilicitanos). El club murciano alegaba que Eze Ponce, quien marcó dos goles en el duelo, arrastraba una sanción en el torneo del K.O. El delantero argentino fue expulsado en el último partido de Copa de su anterior etapa con el Elche, frente al Ceuta (1-0) en enero de 2023. Sin embargo, la entidad del Martínez Valero defendía que su futbolista podía jugar contra el Pinatar, alegando que cumplió su sanción la temporada siguiente con el AEK de Atenas. La justicia ha dado la razón al Elche, rechazando los argumentos del Pinatar. Por tanto, el conjunto entrenado por Martín Anselmi estará presente en la segunda ronda de la Copa del Rey.

articles.title: Un Mallorca con dos caras busca su mejor versión
articles.standfirst: El equipo vuelve el lunes a Son Moix tras dos partidos fuera de casa, donde solo ha ganado un partido esta temporada
articles.summary: El equipo vuelve el lunes a Son Moix tras dos partidos fuera de casa, donde solo ha ganado un partido esta temporada
articles.body: El Mallorca regresa a Son Moix tras dos partidos lejos de la isla en Ipurua y Butarque. Dos partidos completamente opuestos: en Eibar el equipo disputó el mejor encuentro de la temporada a pesar del empate y en Butarque, los de Luis García volvieron a 'perderse', sobre todo desde la salida de Pablo Torre del centro del campo. En los últimos minutos, el Leganés llevo más peligro que los bermellones y acabaron pidiendo la hora en lo que fue otra actuación gris lejos de la isla. Ya la temporada pasada era un aspecto que le costó muchos puntos al Mallorca y, en consecuencia, un descenso a la postre, pero esta campaña no ha mejorado sus prestaciones en ese sentido: tan solo una victoria en Zubieta se antoja muy insuficiente para un equipo obligado a pelear por el ascenso directo. En Son Moix las cosas son totalmente distintas, el Mallorca ha ganado cuatro partidos de cinco posibles (sólo una derrota ante el Almería) en los que ha anotado 10 goles y ha encajado 2. Unas estadísticas que no sostienen una candidatura al ascenso y que Luis García tiene que equiparar si quiere que su equipo logre los objetivos. El Mallorca regresa ahora al calor de la isla, donde si es regular. Una oportunidad para reencontrarse con su mejor versión y despejar las dudas que generan sus actuaciones a domicilio. Porque un nuevo tropiezo, esta vez ante su afición, dispararía los interrogantes de un conjunto con un único cometido, el ascenso directo, del que, de momento, ya se encuentra a cierta distancia.

articles.title: Arteta explica su reacción con Dowman: "No estamos en Disneyland"
articles.standfirst: Varios medios criticaron al técnico por cómo se dirigió a su joven jugador
articles.summary: Varios medios criticaron al técnico por cómo se dirigió a su joven jugador
articles.body: Mikel Arteta, entrenador del Arsenal, explicó su reacción a la expulsión de Max Dowman en la Copa de la Liga, y dijo que no están en Disneyland: "Estamos en la Premier League". El técnico español ha sido criticado en Inglaterra por cómo reaccionó a la expulsión de Dowman por dar una patada a un jugador del Fleetwood Town en la eliminación copera. "No he visto la reacción a mi reacción, sea negativa o positiva. Pero hay que entender el contexto y la relación que tengo con él. Para mí mi mejor reacción es ser yo mismo. Cuando no ganamos, ¿quieres ver mi reacción? Hay que estar preparados para eso. Esta es la realidad. No estamos en Disneyland, estamos en la Premier League y este es el nivel", dijo el entrenador español en rueda de prensa. "Le vamos a cuidar mucho, pero a la vez le vamos a pedir lo mismo que al resto porque tiene que ganarse el derecho a jugar. Hay que ser justo", indicó. Dowman, de 16 años, se perderá los tres próximos partidos del Arsenal después de que el club apelara la tarjeta roja y la federación inglesa de fútbol la desestimara.

articles.standfirst: Los onces de Hansi Flick y de Quique Sánchez Flores
articles.summary: Los onces de Hansi Flick y de Quique Sánchez Flores
articles.body: El Barcelona recibe este sábado 31 de octubre, a las 21.00 horas, al Alavés en el Spotify Camp Nou en el partido correspondiente a la jornada 11 de LaLiga. Los culés presentan dudas, sobre todo, en la parcela defensiva. Las bajas de Christensen, Koundé, Eric García y Xavi Espart obligan al preparador a alinear una zaga inédita. Balde es una opción, pero parece complicado que sea el elegido, ya que el técnico considera que le falta confianza. Todo apunta a que será Brian Fariñas el que ocupará el lateral derecho. En el resto del once no se prevén cambios, aunque habrá que ver si Flick piensa en el partido del martes de Champions contra el Aston Villa y da descanso a algún titular. Fermín seguirá de inicio ante la ausencia de Dani Olmo. El Alavés por su parte, apostará por la defensa de cinco, con Tenaglia, Koski y Valentini afianzados en el eje. Las dos principales dudas vuelven a girar sobre la medular y la delantera, mientras que en ataque Mariano y Toni Martínez pugnan por un puesto al lado de Lucas Boyé. Once probable del Alavés: Sivera, Ángel Pérez, Tenaglia, Koski, Valentini, Rebbach, Blanco, Guevara, Ibáñez, Boyé y Mariano.

articles.title: Baena, el inesperado medio más goleador de LaLiga
articles.standfirst: Con 5 dianas es el único no delantero que aparece entre los 10 primeros de un Pichichi marcado por referencias ofensivas
articles.summary: Con 5 dianas es el único no delantero que aparece entre los 10 primeros de un Pichichi marcado por referencias ofensivas
articles.body: Raphinha, Mbappé y Lamine copan el podio actual del Pichichi. Tres de las grandes estrellas del campeonato son con 13, 11 y 8 dianas los mejores goleadores. Apenas el racinguista Zabiri, con los mismos goles que el 10 del Barça, aguanta un pulso que se prevé durará toda la temporada. Detrás, los delanteros de dos modestos como Osasuna y Rayo, Budimir y Camello. Ambos con siete goles superan en una a Fer Niño, Roberto y Aubameyang, dos meritorios en esto de los goles más una estrella a la que la lesión ha dejado al Deportivo de su principal referencia ofensiva… algo que está pagando como se comprobó en el rendimiento de los gallegos en el Metropolitano. Partido en el que, precisamente, estaba sobre el verde Álex Baena. El 10 del Atlético no marcó, el gol fue de Julián, pero su partido a 0 no impide que siga siendo el medio más goleador de todo el torneo. Y es que sus cinco goles en apenas 10 partidos le convierten en el Pichichi rojiblanco pese a la cantidad de atacantes de nivel que tiene Simeone a su disposición. El paso al frente de Baena, destacado en varias ocasiones por Simeone, tiene clara relación con el último Mundial. En la cita de la segunda estrella se quitó las cadenas que parecía tener en el Metropolitano el pasado curso, quizá influenciando por el precio y las expectativas creadas con su fichaje. Así, ya sin su ídolo Griezmann de compañero, Baena ha conseguido ocupar parte del inmenso hueco que dejó Antoine, que solía desempañarse en la punta de lanza pero también lo hacía más retrasado. No por ello, y esto le liga a Baena, sin perder su llegada al área rival. Pese a que los rojiblancos habían señalado a Kang in como heredero del Principito, la nueva versión del ex rdel Villarreal le coloca más cerca de serlo. El nivel goleador de Baena se refleja claramente en que un jugador de primer nivel como Fermin es el siguiente en la lista de medios goleadores. El del Barça lleva cuatro tantos, uno menos que el 10 del Atlético, siendo los dos únicos no delanteros que han superado de momento las tres dianas en el campeonato de Liga.

articles.title: Sir Patrick Stewart was last seen publicly watching his most beloved football club two years before his death as club announces heartfelt tribute
articles.summary: Huddersfield Town pays tribute to Sir Patrick Stewart, a lifelong supporter, during a match honoring former goalkeeper John Vaughan. Stewart, known for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men, was last seen supporting Huddersfield two years before his death. The club remembers the actor's contributions and legacy.
articles.body: Sir Patrick Stewart spent more than six decades entertaining audiences across theatre, television and cinema, becoming one of Britain's most recognisable actors through his roles in Star Trek and the X-Men films. Away from the screen, however, his loyalties belonged to a football club from his native Yorkshire, and one of his final public appearances saw him cheering on the team he had supported since childhood.Huddersfield to honour Stewart before Bradford clashThe Yorkshire side will travel to Valley Parade for the 12:30 kick-off, where both clubs will also remember former EFL goalkeeper and coach John Vaughan, who died earlier in October. Vaughan had worked with both Huddersfield and Bradford during his coaching career, making the occasion a joint tribute from the two clubs.Huddersfield confirmed the arrangements in a statement on social media, saying:"Tomorrow, we'll join Bradford City in a minute’s applause ahead of kick-off to remember John Vaughan, who sadly passed away earlier this month."Representing both Town and Bradford across his coaching career, we'll come together to honour him before the first whistle."We'll be wearing black armbands in memory of 'Vaughany' and lifelong Town supporter Sir Patrick Stewart, who sadly passed away on Wednesday."You'll always be Terriers."The match also carries significance in the League One standings, with Bradford sitting fourth, three points behind league leaders Huddersfield, and looking to draw level with their Yorkshire rivals.Stewart's final public appearance came at a Huddersfield matchStewart's final public appearance came on November 9, 2024, when he attended Huddersfield's away fixture against Crawley Town at Broadfield Stadium. The actor was photographed in the stands wearing a Huddersfield Town scarf, smiling as he watched the club he had supported since the age of seven.The appearance took place approximately two years before his death, during a period when his declining health had increasingly limited his public engagements. Born in Mirfield, West Yorkshire, Stewart remained fiercely proud of his Yorkshire roots despite spending much of his professional life working internationally and eventually settling in the United States.His attachment to Huddersfield was not simply a passing interest associated with his hometown. He regularly attended matches and remained one of the club's most recognisable supporters, with his presence at games often attracting attention from fellow fans.One of the most memorable occasions came in 2017, when Stewart travelled to Wembley to watch Huddersfield defeat Reading in the Championship play-off final. The victory, secured through a penalty shootout following a goalless draw, returned the Terriers to the Premier League for the first time since 1972.Huddersfield pay tribute to one of their most famous supportersFollowing news of Stewart's death, Huddersfield released an emotional statement recognising his contribution as a supporter and his enduring connection with the town."All at Huddersfield Town are deeply saddened to learn of the passing of lifelong supporter Sir Patrick Stewart."Our thoughts are with his family and loved ones at this sad time. A titan of his craft and a legend and hero to millions worldwide, his legacy will live on."Fiercely proud of his Yorkshire roots, Sir Patrick was a Terrier in every sense, and we're proud to have counted him as one of our own."Once a Terrier, always a Terrier."From Star Trek's Captain Picard to Professor XStewart's career spanned more than 60 years across stage and screen, although international recognition arrived in 1987 when he was cast as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation. His portrayal of the Enterprise captain established him as one of science fiction's most celebrated actors, with the character later returning in several films and the television series Star Trek: PicardHe reached another generation of audiences through his portrayal of Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men film franchise, beginning with the original film in 2000. The character, a powerful mutant who advocates peaceful coexistence between humans and mutants, became one of Stewart's defining screen roles.His career also included extensive work with the Royal Shakespeare Company, reflecting his background as a classically trained stage actor before Hollywood brought him worldwide recognition.Stewart died at his home in Los Angeles on Wednesday, surrounded by his wife, Sunny, following a battle with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia, according to his spokesperson.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Tornike Kvaratskhelia, 'viral' a los 16 años tras un doblete que hubiera firmado su hermano
articles.standfirst: El hermano pequeño de Khvicha firmó un doblete en Youth League
articles.summary: El hermano pequeño de Khvicha firmó un doblete en Youth League
articles.body: Se llama Tornike Kvaratskhelia, tiene apenas 16 años y es imposible que al verlo jugar uno no piense en su hermano Khvicha. Sus goles en UEFA Youth League y la celebración, de estilo y definición clavadas a las del astro del PSG, son el mejor ejemplo de que el jovencísimo talento georgiano ha heredado las cualidades del que hace unos días fuera sexto clasificado en el Balón de Oro. Fueron sus primeros goles desde que empezó a despegar en el Dinamo Tbilisi georgiano. Alternando el primer equipo (ya ha debutado en Liga, Copa y previa de Conference League), fue en la UEFA Youth League (ruta de los campeones) donde saltó al 'estrellato viral' de las redes sociales. Dos tantos en el triunfo sobre el Copenhague (3-0 en la ida; la vuelta, esta próxima semana) lo catapultaron. Uno de los tantos, es producto artesanal de la 'factoría Kvaratskhelia: un eslalon desde el costado que culmina con un disparo con efecto hacia la escuadra del rival. El joven extremo, nacido en 2010 en Tiflis, promete una barbaridad. Por su apellido, por su precocidad (apenas tiene 16 años, cabe insistir) y por el talento que desprenden sus acciones. No es de extrañar que, antes de esta actuación 'viral' en Youth League, ya sonara para clubes como el Bayern de Múnich. Nadie quiere perder de vista al 'nuevo Kvaratskhelia'.

articles.title: Quique: "La victoria del año pasado nos dice que no es imposible ganar al Barcelona"
articles.standfirst: El técnico mantiene el optimismo pese a la mala racha de resultados del equipo
articles.summary: El técnico mantiene el optimismo pese a la mala racha de resultados del equipo
articles.body: Quique Sánchez Flores compareció en la previa de la visita al Camp Nou para analizar las fortalezas del Barcelona y hablar de la situación del Alavés tras seis jornadas sin ganar. Máxima exigencia: "Es un partido de altísima exigencia. Es un equipo de referencia dentro del campeonato y es un equipo de referencia en Europa. La última referencia que tenemos de habernos enfrentado a ellos fue la temporada pasada. El resultado nos dice que no es imposible, porque ya ha sucedido, pero sabemos de la dificultad que tenemos". Plan de partido: "Hay que pensarlo en la medida de que hay cosas de ellos que están muy arraigadas y no van a cambiar. Podemos adaptarnos a la situación. Pensamos dónde queremos defender, qué situaciones podemos manejar para no sentirnos del todo incómodos todo el tiempo. Y sabemos que es un partido de oportunidades. El partido nos dará alguna que otra oportunidad y ahí tenemos que estar muy acertados. Luego conceder lo menos posible, porque es un equipo que te va a buscar grietas por todos lados y nosotros tendremos que estar firmes". Dinámica negativa: "Nos hemos reunido para hablar de sensaciones y de cómo nos encontramos. Son rachas que pueden pasar en un equipo como el nuestro. Nos reunimos para hablar de nuestras esencias, dónde están nuestros patrones y cómo los queremos recuperar. Esto es un recorrido, es una dinámica. Igual que en las favorables todo vuela, en las que no son favorables todo pesa. Y hay que cambiarlo". Barcelona: "Juegan bien, se sitúan bien, se posicionan bien en ataque, han mejorado defensivamente sus patrones. Es un equipo que recupera la pelota muy rápido, es un equipo que te hace muchas cosas bien con muchos jugadores de la cantera y con muchos jugadores jóvenes, lo cual enamora mucho. Es un partido que nos va a tener todo el tiempo en alerta. Accidente de Toledo: "Lamentablemente ocurrió lo que ocurrió y desde aquí mandamos el pésame a todas las familias de los fallecidos y los heridos". Toni Martínez: "Cada día está mejor. El gran inconveniente que tuvo es que se lesionó cuando todavía no estaba bien. Son jugadores que no tardan lo mismo en ponerse en forma que otros finos y otros ligeros. No tengo ninguna duda sobre Toni. Pero ninguna. Va a ser importantísimo y va a conseguir los mismos goles que la temporada pasada o más. Lo tengo clarísimo".

articles.title: 'Dibu' Martínez: "Tengo la sensación que hoy le ganamos a España"
articles.standfirst: El portero argentino habla sobre su lesión y el pasado Mundial
articles.summary: El portero argentino habla sobre su lesión y el pasado Mundial
articles.body: El Dibu Martínez es una figura que no deja indiferente a nadie. El portero del Chelsea y la selección argentina, en una entrevista en el podcast de "Los Edul", se sinceró sobre su estado físico tras su lesión y habló sobre el pasado Mundial, dejando un controvertido y claro mensaje de revancha: "Si íbamos a los penaltis ganábamos. Sentía que era mi día. Sientes que no va a entrar. Francia en 2022 me impuso más que esta España. Son muy buenos, pero tengo la sensación de que hoy les ganamos", sentenció. "Fue como un K.O de la UFC. Me desmayé y no recuerdo nada. Me pusieron una placa en el hospital y me agarraron tres dientes. Arrastré la lesión desde la final de la Europa League. Los médicos me colocaron un yeso y pude entrenar las primeras semanas tirándome solo con un brazo. Días antes de la final ya pude hacerlo con total normalidad". "Él me esperó hasta el último momento. Jugué todo el Mundial con el dedo fracturado. Solo me hizo prometerle que le sería sincero de cara a si estaría bien para jugar o no un partido". "Yo necesito jugar con la selección. Mi intención es volver en el parón de selecciones". Me gustaría irme como Messi. Nos enseñó todo; el caer y levantarse después del fracaso. Eso me ayudó después del Mundial. Tengo pensado seguir con la selección hasta el día en el que sienta que no puedo dar más".

articles.title: Hearts v Hibs: Rivals braced  for 'all or nothing' semi-final
articles.summary: Hearts and Hibernian are braced for a winner-takes-all League Cup semi-final. But the Edinburgh rivals arrive at Hampden in very different moods.
articles.body:
On Sunday, fans of Hearts and Hibernian will make the same journey to Hampden but the Edinburgh rivals have been on different paths so far this season.

Hearts sold out their initial allocation for the Premier Sports Cup semi-final in three days, then snapped up a second wave to take their numbers over 23,000.

That a few seats will be empty at the other end of the national stadium signals a degree of trepidation among followers of Hibs.

Still, more than 18,000 will be there to cheer on the team sitting second bottom of the Premiership, having taken a mere two points from their past eight outings.

Hearts lie third and enjoyed their third successive derby victory in early September. Hearts can also boast a 100% record in derbies played at Hampden, all coming in the Scottish Cup.

The teams have been going at it since Christmas Day 1875 but had to wait until 2006 for a first meeting in Glasgow's Southside.

Paul Hartley scored a hat-trick in a 4-0 semi-final triumph, while Hibs had two players sent off.

Then came the 2012 final, a 5-1 demolition, with a double from Rudi Skacel and a red card for the losers.

The past two contests were closer, Hearts prevailing 2-1 each time in the semi-finals of 2020 and 2022, with yet another Hibs dismissal in the latter to go with the pain of a missed penalty in the former.

Premier Sports Cup semi-final: Hearts v Hibernian

Live commentary on BBC Radio Scotland, follow the action on BBC Sport app and website.

Reedijk denied first Hibs win by late St Mirren leveller

This is a first competitive match between managers that were on track to meet in the Belgian top flight this season before stepping away.

Wouter Vrancken steered Sint-Truiden to third, their best finish in 60 years, while Marink Reedijk enjoyed a remarkable 'invincibles' second tier title success with Beveren.

Reedijk is still waiting for his first Hibs victory, a drab draw at St Mirren on Wednesday following three defeats for the Dutchman who replaced David Gray and has set about implementing a new style at Easter Road.

While the structure is evolving, Hibs remain defensively fragile, without a league clean sheet, and have been blunt in attack.

In Reedijk's first game, Hibs had four efforts on target, then three, then two, while the goal at St Mirren came from the only one.

In their past four domestic outings, Hearts have had 22 attempts on target and that includes a 7-1 mauling at Celtic.

Vrancken's side have 24 league goals to Hibs' 11, three of those coming at Easter Road when they completely bossed the first half, showing far greater energy and intensity than the hosts.

"You have to put your emotions and energy in the things you have to do on the pitch and go from there," said Vrancken. "We did really well there and we have to do also on Sunday.

"It's a totally different game. New manager, new style, new competition. It's also an all-or-nothing game. So all different circumstances. The first game doesn't matter anymore. We have to look forward to this one."

Meanwhile, Reedijk is looking forward to a "special match" with "some surprises somewhere", adding: "It's not only the derby, it's also a semi-final, and it's one step away from a final, so that is a double way of excitement."

Having come so close in the title race last season, some silverware would go a long way to underline Hearts' credentials as disruptors of the established order.

The Tynecastle side haven't lifted a trophy since their colossal party in 2012 and last got their hands on the League Cup in 1962.

Hibs have won the competition three times in that time.

Both teams have long injury lists, but the return of the experienced Martin Boyle, scorer of five derby goals, is a boost for Hibs. The 33-year-old lit up the 2021 semi-finals with a first-half hat-trick in a win over Rangers.

Boyle has three league goals, making him the club's top scorer.

Hearts have five players on three goals or more, Claudio Braga and Calvin Miller both moving on to five in Wednesday's thrilling draw at home to Rangers.

After dominating for long spells, Vrancken's men did fade in that game and might have lost at the death if not for a mis-timed jump from Dujon Sterling.

Early exits from both cup competitions perhaps benefited Hearts' surprise league challenge last time but, with Conference League group games in the mix this time, the action is coming thick and fast.

Can Hibs stay in the game long enough to test that stamina? A foolish sending off killed their momentum in the last derby after pulling a goal back and they certainly cannot afford to add to that list of Hampden red cards.

articles.title: Mou se mira en la Liga de los Récords
articles.standfirst: En ese campeonato sólo cedió tras 10 jornadas un punto menos que en este, para acabar batiendo todos los registros del torneo
articles.summary: En ese campeonato sólo cedió tras 10 jornadas un punto menos que en este, para acabar batiendo todos los registros del torneo
articles.body: La Liga de los Récords (100 puntos y 121 goles) es la obra magna de la primera etapa de José Mourinho en el Real Madrid. En aquel campeonato, el equipo blanco superó todos los registros de la Liga española, batiendo los registros del poderoso Barça de Guardiola o Luis Enrique, entre otros, y estableciendo marcas que tampoco han podido ser superadas con posterioridad por los equipos estratosféricos del Madrid con Zidane o Ancelotti. Con todo, conviene poner en perspectiva aquel torneo, sobre todo si lo comparamos con el de esta temporada. Aquel Madrid de Mou 11-12 empezó la Liga con dos tropiezos consecutivos, una derrota en Valencia ante el Levante (1-0) y un empate en Santander (0-0) que hundieron al equipo en la séptima posición de la tabla. Aquellos dos tropiezos en apenas cinco jornadas supusieron la pérdida de sólo un punto menos que los que han provocado las dos derrotas del Madrid en este curso, ante Betis (jornada 4) y Atlético de Madrid (7). De hecho, el Madrid de la 11-12 sólo pudo acceder al liderato en la jornada 11, la misma que curiosamente se disputa este próximo fin de semana y en la que el Madrid, aunque no depende únicamente de sí mismo, puede atacar de nuevo la cabeza de la tabla gracias a su triunfo del pasado domingo en Barcelona. En la undécima jornada de aquella Liga 11-12, el Madrid se impuso en Anoeta a la Real Sociedad por 0-1. Fue la sexta victoria consecutiva de los blancos, que llegaron a firmar una racha de diez triunfos seguidos, fundamentales para llenar el granero de cara al futuro. Aunque en realidad casi no hizo falta. El Madrid sólo cedió nueve puntos más en el resto de la competición, que aseguró de forma virtual tras un triunfo en el Camp Nou por 1-2 gracias un gol de Cristiano a pase de Özil que a muchos les recordó la jugada entre Güler y Camavinga del pasado domingo, previa al gol ganador de Mbappé. En lo que sí hubo una notable diferencia fue en el aspecto goleador. Aquel Madrid era una máquina de anotar, y su media en los 10 primeros partidos de Liga subió hasta los 3,5 goles por encuentro. El ritmo bajó ligeramente en el resto de la competición, aunque los 121 goles finales arrojaron una media de 3,18 dianas por duelo. Las cifras de este curso 26-27 son más modestas, con 25 tantos anotados en 10 partidos 2,5 de media, que suben hasta los casi 2,7 si se suman los tres partidos de Champions disputados hasta ahora, ante Inter, Roma y Leipzig. Un total de 35 tantos que sólo superan en las grandes Ligas Barcelona (51) y Bayern de Múnich (47).

articles.title: Flick convinced Barcelona will bounce back from successive defeats
articles.summary: Hansi Flick is convinced Barcelona will rebound from the painful back-to-back defeats to Paris Saint-Germain and bitter rivals Real Madrid. Barça welcome Ala...
articles.body:
Hansi Flick is convinced Barcelona will rebound from the painful back-to-back defeats to Paris Saint-Germain and bitter rivals Real Madrid.

Barça welcome Alaves to the Nou Camp in LaLiga on Saturday looking to bounce back from a 2-1 home El Clásico setback that followed a 4-2 loss at the Champions League holders in France.

Those results brought Barcelona's 11-match winning run at the start of the new season to a crashing halt and even led the club's board of directors to publicly back coach Flick ahead of their return to action.

"The board has reaffirmed its full confidence in the men's first team squad and coaching staff," the club said following Thursday's meeting.

"Despite recent results, the team's enthusiasm and ambition remain undiminished, with the utmost commitment to facing the challenges of the season."

That backing was put to Flick, who has won La Liga in both seasons since taking charge, and he said: "I spoke with the president (Joan Laporta, I'm in contact with (sporting director) Deco and of course it's a nice gesture.

"But, at the end, I know this situation. We lost two important games in one week. But I'm 100% convinced, 100% convinced about my team. I'm doing my job here the best I can, and nothing changed.

"I don't lose any per cent of attitude, mentality to coach this fantastic club, to coach this fantastic team, so I'm very happy to be here and it changed nothing.

"Also in football, we won the first 11 games. Of course, now we have two defeats, so we have to come back on the street to victories. This is our job, what we have to do.

"But I'm 100% convinced about our idea, how we want to play football. I think it also the best for this team so we go this way until the end."

Alaves, who sit seventh in the standings, could make life difficult for Barça, who will be without injured defenders Jules Koundé, Andreas Christensen, Eric Garcia and Xavi Espart.

Head coach Flick said: "It's a long, long way to the end of the season where you can win the titles, and I think also now is a good moment. Nothing happens really bad.

"Of course we lost against Real. No one here loves it – the players not, me not, the fans not, the club not – but at the end we have to manage it.

"I think it was also possible to win this game and we had also great chances, but we have to accept this defeat, and we do it. We have to find solutions and this is how we have to manage it.

"We try to give the best but for tomorrow, it's clear. The most important thing is to win three points."

Barcelona head coach Hansi Flick tested a head-turning new backline of players during the club's latest training session on Friday morning.

This of course comes as the German and his staff are forced to deal with an ongoing personnel crisis in the Blaugrana's defence.

Flick is currently unable to call upon any of Andreas Christensen, Jules Koundé, Eric García and Xavi Espart, owing to respective injury problems.

This leaves just four senior defenders currently fit and available for selection in Catalunya's capital, namely João Cancelo, Pau Cubarsí, Gerard Martín and Alejandro Balde.

As alluded to above, though, this did not stop Hansi Flick from testing an altogether different back-four in training ahead of his side's La Liga meeting with Deportivo Alavés on Saturday.

articles.title: The 10 best true freshmen in college football so far this season, from Jesse Legree to Kenny Darby
articles.summary: Oregon State's Jesse Legree may get all the headlines, but several other new faces are making waves in 2026.
articles.body:
True freshmen starting in Division I college football used to be a rarity. But in 2026, several true freshman stars are lighting up the stat sheet.

From quarterbacks to wide receivers, running backs and defensive stars, several teams across the country are benefiting from true freshman standouts.

With the 2026 season more than halfway over, here's a look at the best overall true freshmen in college football so far this season and where each was ranked as a high school recruit.

All recruiting rankings via the 247Sports Composite. MORE: The Sporting Nwws midseason All-America teams

Player Details: 6-foot-2, 215 pounds from Queen Creek, Ariz., 19 years old

Prospect Rating: Three-star QB (No. 34 in position, 554th overall, No. 6 out of Arizona

The true freshman quarterback options are not great, as Jared Curtis has been turnover-prone in recent weeks. But to show some love to our signal-callers here, we'll go with Clemson's Tait Reynolds.

Clemson is 4-3 on the season, and Reynolds has thrown for 1,096 yards. He has thrown more interceptions (3) than touchdowns (1) this year, but he's also completed 66.7% of his passes. His best game so far came during the Tigers' 28-20 win over UNC on Sept. 19, when he finished with 215 passing yards, a touchdown and 26 yards on the ground.

Player Details: 6-foot-3, 205 pounds from Manhattan, Kan., 18 years old

Prospect Rating: 4-star safety (No. 12 in position, 115th overall, No. 2 out of Kansas)

Miami's defense is not the strongest part of Mario Cristobal's Canes team, as it is primarily led by the offense. In fact, we have one of Dunnigan's offensive teammates next on this list.

But as a true freshman, Dunnigan is a star. He is second on the team in tackles, with 28 total tackles, including a pick-six and a forced fumble. His pick-six came on the road against Clemson:

Last week after Miami's dominant 52-23 win over Pitt, Dunnigan was graded as the highest-graded safety of the week per Pro Football Focus.

Player Details: (5-foot-11, 210 pounds from Fort Lauderdale, Fla., 19 years old)

Prospect Rating: 4-star running back (No. 28 in position, 418th overall, No. 54 out of Florida)

Although much of the focus on Miami's run game has been on established star Mark Fletcher, true freshman Javian Mallory has been playing well in recent weeks.

He leads the Canes on the ground with 444 yards and seven touchdowns and is averaging 7.51 yards per carry, tied for ninth in the country. He's also scored two touchdowns in each of Miami's last two games.

Player Details: 6-foot-1, 279 pounds from Suwanee, Ga., 19 years old

Prospect Rating: 4-star defensive lineman (No. 4 in position, 56th overall, No. 6 out of Georgia)

LSU's defense has several transfer portal stars and upperclassmen that lead the unit. But a pleasant surprise so far this season has been Deuce Geralds.

He has 24 total tackles so far, including 13 solo stops. He is also tied for second on the team with five sacks on the season. He also forced a fumble against Louisiana Tech:

He should only get better learning the defense as LSU faces tough remaining games this season against Alabama, Texas and Tennessee.

Player Details: 6-foot, 215 pounds from Salisbury, NC, 20 years old

Prospect Rating: Three-star running back (No. 53 in position, 835th overall, No. 31 out of North Carolina)

Jamal Rule leads Nebraska in rushing, with 391 yards and two touchdowns so far this season. He has also added four receptions for 82 yards and a touchdown in the passing game.

His best game came during Nebraska's Week 1 win over Ohio, as he finished with 167 total yards of offense and three total touchdowns, including 122 on the ground:

He has yet to find the end zone since September, however, so that will have to change if the Cornhuskers want to have a strong finish to the season. MORE: Tracking the FBS coaching changes for 2026

Player Details: 6-foot-1, 180 pounds, from Bossier City, La., 19 years old

Prospect Rating: 4-star running back (No. 36 in position, 218th overall, No. 8 out of Louisiana)

Kentucky is having a dream season of sorts under first-year head coach Will Stein. The Wildcats are 7-1 on the season and ranked ninth in the country. Did we mention Kentucky is tied for first in the SEC alongside Georgia? What a time!

A big reason for the Wildcats' offensive success is quarterback Kenny Minchey, who has a favorite target in Darby. The receiver leads UK with 38 receptions for 507 yards and three touchdowns. He is also averaging 13.3 yards per catch.

His best game came during Kentucky's 35-34 overtime win against South Carolina, when he finished with 12 receptions for 96 yards and a touchdown.

Player Details: 6-foot-1, 175 pounds from Lehi, Utah, Age Unknown

Prospect Rating: Three-star wide receiver (No. 34 in position, 666th overall, No. 13 out of Utah)

BYU dropped out of the Big 12 and College Football Playoff conversation a bit with the Cougars double-overtime loss to UCF. But a huge reason for BYU's 6-1 start to the season is how well Glasker has been playing.

The true freshman is BYU's leading receiver and favorite target for Bear Bachmeir. So far this season he has 28 receptions for 498 yards and four touchdowns.

Against Colorado State, he had a season-high five receptions for 131 yards, and scored three total touchdowns during BYU's season-opener against Utah Tech

Player Details: 5-foot-10, 180 pounds from Chicago, Ill., 20 years old

Prospect Rating: 4-star wide receiver (No. 39 in position, 251st overall, No. 23 out of California.

Next up we have a pair of back-to-back USC Trojans, as both of them have been studs for Lincoln Riley so far.

First is Trent Moseley, who is second on the team in receiving with 27 receptions for 411 yards and five touchdowns, which leads USC. He is averaging 15.2 yards per receptions, as well. He has three games so far this season with over 100 yards receiving, against San Jose State, Fresno State and Penn State, scoring at least one touchdown in all three of those.

Player Details: 6-foot-2, 200 pounds from Hayward, Calif., 19 years old

Prospect Rating: 4-star wide receiver (No. 9 in position, 59th overall, No. 8 out of California)

USC's leading receiver in front of Mosley is Kayden Dixon-Wyatt, who is also not playing like a true freshman. So far this year, he has 32 receptions for 443 yards with four touchdowns.

One of his best catches came earlier this season against Rutgers:

He has had multiple games so far this season where he is averaging over 10 yards per catch, as well.

Player Details: 5-foot-10, 172 pounds, from Baltimore, MD, Exact age unknown

Prospect Rating: Three-star WR (No. 118th in position, 1,713 overall, No. 35 out of Maryland)

I mean, is there any debate about who is No. 1 here. Jesse Legree has taken the college football world by storm, helping little old Oregon State get out to a 5-2 start to the season.

He currently leads the nation in receiving with 1,040 yards and 14 touchdowns, ahead of stars in Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith and Miami's Malachi Toney. He is also averaging 22.61 yards per catch, which also leads the country.

Legree is also on-pace to break a freshman record this season. At 14 scores, he is behind leaders Michael Crabtree of Texas Tech (22)

and Jeremiah Smith (15) as record-holders for touchdown catches in a single season. He has scored just one touchdown in two Oregon State games so far this season, so it would be surprising if he didn't break that record.

He is also the second FBS player in history in 30 yards to get at least 100 receiving yards and a touchdown in his team's first seven games, according to ESPN . That puts him up there with Oklahoma State's Justin Blackmon in 2010.

articles.title: Barcelona dressing room questions Flick’s strict hotel routine amid growing player fatigue – report
articles.summary: Barcelona suffered consecutive defeats against PSG and Real Madrid in the UEFA Champions League and La Liga, bringing their perfect record to an abrupt end.A...
articles.body:
Barcelona suffered consecutive defeats against PSG and Real Madrid in the UEFA Champions League and La Liga, bringing their perfect record to an abrupt end.

After the Clasico , Hansi Flick cited a lack of freshness as one reason why his team were unable to perform at their best.

However, according to Xavi Hernandez Navarro of ARA , some Barcelona players have reservations about the amount of time they spend in hotels between matches.

The demanding schedule tends to keep players away from their families, and some are said to be displeased with Flick's insistence on hotel stays.

Barcelona players question Flick's approach to recovery

The disagreement became apparent following Barcelona's 5-2 victory over Real Betis at Estadio de La Cartuja.

Severe weather prevented the squad from flying home that night. While the captains preferred to wait at the airport in the hope that conditions would improve, Flick eventually ordered everyone to stay at a hotel in Seville.

Barcelona captains wanted to wait at the airport at Seville. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images)

The players returned to Barcelona only the following day. Two days later, they had to travel to Paris to take on the defending Ligue 1 and European champions.

Flick was of the opinion that the disrupted schedule affected their preparation for PSG and Real Madrid.

The German manager has also employed sleep consultant Anna West, who is tasked with monitoring everything from bedroom temperatures and bedding to screen usage and sleeping habits.

However, some players are said to believe that it is better to have dinner, see their children and sleep in their own beds rather than at a hotel.

A familiar debate in the Barcelona dressing room

The fascinating thing about this development is that this is not a new issue at Barcelona.

Former captains Carles Puyol and Xavi Hernandez had previously pushed to reduce what they deemed unnecessary hotel stays.

Hansi Flick needs to find a solution to balance his demands with the squad's morale. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images)

Pep Guardiola and Luis Enrique eventually gave in to some of those requests. Flick, however, has maintained a stricter approach.

The German manager is the kind of person who pays attention to every minute detail, and the players' sleep schedules are part of that.

However, recovery involves more than just getting the sleeping schedule right. Sometimes, players feel mentally refreshed just by being at home with their loved ones.

The challenge for Flick is to find that balance without compromising on his strict standards.

Barcelona face another demanding run of fixtures, with games against Aston Villa and Atletico Madrid coming up over the next week. It remains to be seen whether Flick does something different in terms of recovery in the coming weeks.

articles.title: Milan boss Ruben Amorim relishing 'special match' against rivals Inter
articles.summary: Coach Ruben Amorim believes the Milan derby against Inter on Saturday will be a “special match” as he looks to bounce back from AC Milan’s first league defea...
articles.body:
Coach Ruben Amorim believes the Milan derby against Inter on Saturday will be a "special match" as he looks to bounce back from AC Milan's first league defeat of the season.

Milan went down 4-2 at home to Bologna following a second-half collapse in the week and need a result against their city rivals and Serie A leaders if they are to avoid being cut adrift already.

The gap between the teams will stretch to 10 points should Amorim's side lose and the manager is more than aware of the magnitude of the fixture.

"It's a special match, a unique rivalry between two great teams from the same city who share the same stadium," he said. "We know how important this fixture is, and we have a responsibility to win.

"When you play matches like these, the circumstances and fatigue don't matter. You have to step on to the pitch and give it your all and that's exactly what we'll do. Inter is a team that can play with its eyes closed.

"Even when it changes players, it always knows what to do. It has an outstanding ability to read the different phases of a match, thanks to its experience and the many successes it has enjoyed. Inter has plenty of talent, but we're here to fight and we'll be ready.

"We were very angry after Bologna, but today I saw a team completely focused on the derby, fully committed to the technical and tactical work and aware of what it needs to do on the pitch."

Milan were beaten 3-0 by Bournemouth in the Europa League last week and their wobble continued into their domestic campaign as Bologna hit them with three second-half goals to come from behind and win.

For champions Inter there are no such concerns and manager Cristian Chivu said he is treating it as just another match as he looks to pull clear of Lazio at the summit.

"We know Milan's quality and we must be ready," he said. "We need to approach this as just another league match, without looking at the standings or focusing on external factors.

"We must be the best version of ourselves. If Inter hasn't won a derby in six or seven meetings, you have to ask yourself some questions.

"We need balance and a high level of motivation; it will require a bit more sacrifice than other matches."
